_comment: Sonni on the Money Lab self-hosted runtime. On Sonni's own VPS, sonni/vps/configure.mjs writes this into ~/.automaton/automaton.json (see sonni/GUIDE-VPS.fr.md). Secrets are NOT stored here: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (a dedicated key, in its own Anthropic workspace with a monthly spend limit) and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (a separate bot from Money Lab's) come from the environment file. Amounts are USD cents. funding.provisionedCents is the monthly inference envelope (about 50 EUR at the owner's rate); the owner adds the next month with /fonds. dailyCents paces it (1/30 of the month). The VPS is paid by the owner outside Sonni's budget, so its cost here is 0. Replace ownerChatId. Code denies Money Lab's web-business tools when the trader block is present. readers are free assistant models (OpenAI-compatible endpoints) used only to read headlines and pages: their keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY) are optional and live in the environment file; a reader whose key is absent is skipped. curiosity caps Sonni's self-wakes.
